# Two template files of one package have the same base name, index.gohtml.
# html/template keeps what both define, and so does muxt's template engine:
# the tests pass under go test and under muxt test. Blocks reached under the
# shared name cannot be placed in one file, so the cover profile leaves them
# out and muxt test says so.

exec go test ./...
stdout '^ok  \texample.com/amb\t'

muxt test --output-cover-profile cover.out
stdout '^ok  \texample.com/amb\t'
cmpenv stderr want-stderr.txt
cmp cover.out want-cover.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/amb

go 1.24
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "a"}}{{if .}}top{{end}}{{end}}
-- sub/index.gohtml --
{{define "b"}}{{if .}}sub{{end}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package amb

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml sub/*.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml")).ParseFS(templateFiles, "sub/*.gohtml"))

func Render(w io.Writer, v bool) error {
	if err := templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "a", v); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "b", v)
}
-- render_test.go --
package amb

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRender(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&buf, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "topsub"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("Render = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want-stderr.txt --
warning: $WORK/index.gohtml and $WORK/sub/index.gohtml share the parse name index.gohtml; the cover profile leaves out its blocks
-- want-cover.txt --
mode: set
